discussions.prompt: This record routes two independent paths to immune evasion -- complement-regulator binding by surface proteins, and effector delivery through the T3SS. In a given host, is either route sufficient on its own, or does established infection require both?
discussions.rationale: The graph draws both arrows into the same node without saying whether they are alternatives or partners. If either is sufficient, single-target antivirulence strategies are viable; if evasion needs both, only combination approaches will work, and the two edges should carry that dependency rather than reading as parallel routes.

proposed_experiments.name: Isogenic single- and double-mutant serum and phagocyte survival
proposed_experiments.approach: isogenic mutant panel with ex vivo killing assays
model_systems: isolate of a T3SS-bearing animal pathogen
primary phagocytes from the same host species
perturbations: deletion of the complement-regulator binding protein
deletion of the T3SS structural apparatus
readouts: surface-bound complement regulator by flow cytometry
proposed_experiments.decision_criterion: whether either single mutant is attenuated to the same degree as the double mutant
proposed_experiments.would_support: single mutants retain near-wild-type survival and only the double is attenuated -- the routes are independently sufficient
proposed_experiments.would_refute: either single mutant is attenuated as severely as the double -- the routes are not redundant and evasion requires both

discussions.prompt: Distinguish nutritional cannibalism from broader developmental usage.
discussions.rationale: This class retains the classical killing-and-feeding sense. Friebel et al. 2026 also calls the wider toxin-dependent biofilm differentiation program cannibalism; that usage need not satisfy this narrower nutritional definition. The predatory bacterium parent traitmech:000054 fits this operational scope, not every phenotype assigned that name in the literature. Bacteriocin production traitmech:000183 requires neither conspecific killing nor feeding. Saprotrophy traitmech:000055 does not require killing the food source; natural competence traitmech:000087 concerns DNA uptake. Fratricide, programmed cell death, biofilm formation and sporulation delay are not exact synonyms. Resolve broader terminology and external mappings before adding xrefs; do not assume species-level disjointness.

discussions.prompt: Resolve exact mappings without conflating trophic endpoints.
discussions.rationale: Follow Leveau and Preston's active nutritional definition and explicit oomycete scope, without classifying oomycetes as true fungi or asserting experimentally demonstrated feeding on every target group. Merely consuming passive leaks or tissue dead through unrelated causes is excluded. Fungal inhibition, lysis, chitinase activity or a sequence annotation alone is insufficient. Killing and obligate fungal dependence are not required. Predatory bacterium traitmech:000054 requires bacterial prey; saprotrophy traitmech:000055 concerns dead material; parasitism traitmech:000043 requires host harm; phagotrophy traitmech:000628 requires particle ingestion. None is an established broader parent here. No organism-level disjointness is asserted. Unqualified mycophagy, fungivory and mycetophagy also cover nonbacterial organisms and are not exact synonyms. No exact xref or synonym assigned pending authority/scope reconciliation.
